lines: We live in an age of opportunity: If you’ve got ambition, energy, and intelligence, you can become the best in your field.
Companies today aren’t managing the careers of their knowledge workers, who produce ideas and information.
Rather, we must be our own chief executive officer.
That is to say, it’s up to you to keep yourself focused and productive during a work life.
To do all of these things well, you’ll need to understand yourself deeply.
What are your most valuable strengths and most dangerous weaknesses?
How do you learn and work with others?
What are your most important values?
The conclusion is clear: When you mix your strengths with self-understanding, you can achieve true—and lasting—excellence at work.
